notes.content:
The game will become free to play in the next few days :)
Thanks a lot to all previous buyers, we hope this will allow you to brings your friends into the depths of the Amber Cage !

notes.title: Patch note - Tutorial Upgrade
notes.content:
- The tutorial have been upgraded and is now mandatory.
- French Localization now available.

notes.title: Patch note 1.0.2
notes.content:
- Low level players move more quickly.
- Low level player cast spells more quickly.
- Monsters do less damages on beginner, standard and expert difficulty.
- Monsters have less hitpoints especially on beginner and standard difficulty.

The first hours should now feel a lot less punishing and let you learn combat mechanics properly :)

notes.title: Wardens of the Amber Cage Successfully Released \o/
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994497/091e5e9992cfb13c867e39adf3af20534fa2d168.jpg[/img]
Welcome to our news players, we're pleased to announce the game release went well :)

We are still patching some last minute issues we identified thanks to your feedbacks and game should work well.

If you experience an issue, please contact us via steam forum, by mail at gembasher@protonmail.com or by steam messaging a developper (you can find me in the forum).

We are now looking for player feedback to improve the game. 

A first request which came up a lot will be about the experience system : starting next patch you will now automatically level-up in dungeon, without having to come back at the leveling station in the start hub.

We will also soon post explanations about how to use the differents mage specializations.

Happy leveling and see you in Challenge leaderboards!

notes.title: VR Controller/Gamepad Hotfix

notes.title: Patch note : 0.3.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The game speed have been increased a lot.
[*] You can now use teleportation for free while no monsters are in range.
[*] You can now use the black gate to get to the deepest purificated checkpoint. The old teleporter was disabled.
[*] You must now purificate a checkpoint in order to unlock it's doors.
[*] You can now rebind all controls on gamepad and keyboard.
[*] VR : you can now use the keyboard to play while seated with a VR headset.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch note : 0.3.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] There is now more variety in the mazes.
[*] The range of the teleport spell has been increased- it is now more consistent with its equivalent spells in the other mage specs (which are currently unavailable).
[*] The necromancers have been modified.
[*] You can reassign the input bindings in the option menu.
[*] You can now invert the vertical axis on the mouse and the gamepad.
[*] Xbox gamepad rotations have been improved. You can now spin around more quickly.
[*] The Discovery mode has been added in the difficulty settings. Monsters are slower and you have a lot more hit points, so even the newbies can have fun in the game without having to go through the ‘die and retry’ learning phase.
[*] From now on, the checkpoint doors are locked until you activate the checkpoint.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Opening
notes.content:
Early access has begun and the game is now available for sale.

Be warned, it's the beginning of the content development phase so the game is short and lack long term challenge (From beta feedback expect around 2h of gameplay in the current game state). 

Only buy it now if you are curious or/and want to help it's development.

Trying to be synthetic curently your expected experience should take around  look like (from closed beta feedback) :

- Make you first dungeon run in beginner mode to discovers the gameplay and learn combat.

- Make a second dungeon run in standard mode.

- Once you are at ease with standard mode you should try expert mode where monster gain new powers. Expert mode is challenging, especially in virtual reality.

- Current 'end game' is the timer. You can compete with your friends on the leaderboards and try to make the quickest dungeon run possible. Leaderboard currently only concern solo content and can be affected by the random aspect of the dungeon generation.

Happy crawling and see you soon for next update !

notes.title: Wardens of the Amber Cage : Closed Beta Gameplay test begin
notes.content: Closed Beta 0.2.1 is out with the first iteration of the difficulty settings balancing.

notes.title: Wardens of the Amber Cage : Closed Beta Opening
notes.content:
The closed beta is available. Gameplay tests will begin on Monday.
[list]
    [*] Beginner, Standard and Expert difficulty settings are available.
    [*] Beginner skill set is available.
    [*] The undead king boss is available.
    [*] The swordman, the crossbowman, the assassin and the necromancer are available.
    [*] A basic room set is available.
    [*] Multiplayer is available.
    [*] Progress system is disabled during beta.
[/list] 
We should be able to announce an early access release date in the following weeks.

notes.title: Patch note : Free Alpha Preview 0.1.13
notes.content:
- Monsters now loot healing orbs.
- Healing orbs should ensure you are full life when pulling boss (ghosts will still oneshot you from behind).
- Boss cinematic improved and now have a short version once you wipe.
- Direct boss teleporter when dungeon is empty should be more visible.
- Spell reflects should be more visible (and frequent, sorry).
- Various bugfixes and minor visual improvements.

notes.title: Alpha Preview Available
notes.content:
A demonstration preview is available to download, including multiplayer and a short level with a boss.

Matchmaking is currently totally public, we will add a friends-only lobbying in the future if needed.
